description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_postgres64' extending 'ADOConnection', which implements a database driver for PostgreSQL 64-bit in the ADODB database abstraction library. It includes methods for database connection management, executing queries, retrieving metadata, and handling large objects/blobs. Additionally, it defines a derived recordset class 'ADORecordSet_postgres64' for fetching and processing query results.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres64
classes.description: A PHP class implementing PostgreSQL 64-bit database driver functionality, including connection, query execution, transaction control, metadata retrieval, and blob handling.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres64
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADORecordSet to handle PostgreSQL 64-bit query result sets, including blob decoding and flexible field retrieval.
